title: Range gate
prompt: Implement `static bool IsValidScore(string input)` — true exactly when input parses to an int from 0 to 100 inclusive. `"100"` true, `"101"` false, `"abc"` false, `"-1"` false.

tests.name: in-range
tests.hint: Both endpoints inclusive; trimming is expected.

tests.name: out-of-range
tests.hint: Out of range and non-numeric both fail closed.
